name: 2D Grid Set Isomorphism
description: Translates the 1D job scheduling problem into a 2D grid coordinate selection problem. Jobs become rows, time stages become columns, and phase assignments become sets of coordinates. This forces the model to deduce the aggregate sum constraints from geometric rules (Row Cardinality, Column Sparsity, Strict Abscissa Precedence) rather than relying on standard job-scheduling heuristics.
